verdicts.title: Group algebras whose units satisfy a Laurent Polynomial Identity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $KG$ be the group algebra of a torsion group $G$ over a field $K$. We show that if the units of $KG$ satisfy a Laurent polynomial identity which is not satisfied by the units of the relative free algebra $K[α,β: α^2=β^2=0]$ then $KG$ satisfies a polynomial identity. This extends Hartley Conjecture which states that if the units of $KG$ satisfies a group identity then $KG$ satisfies a polynomial identity.
